acceptance: contain: partly enclosed rectangle is not selected: given contain mode; rectangle x 300 y 300 100x100; partial lasso over its left half, expect nothing selected
overlap: partly enclosed rectangle is selected: given overlap mode; same rectangle and partial lasso, expect the rectangle is selected
contain: rectangle the lasso only crosses is not selected: given contain mode; rectangle x 300 y 300 100x100; crossing band lasso, expect nothing selected
overlap: rectangle the lasso only crosses is selected: given overlap mode; same rectangle and crossing band lasso, expect the rectangle is selected
contain: fully enclosed rectangle is selected: given contain mode; rectangle x 300 y 300 100x100; surrounding lasso, expect the rectangle is selected
contain: fully enclosed rotated rectangle is selected: given contain mode; rectangle x 300 y 300 160x60 angle 0.6; rectangular lasso x 240..520, y 240..420, expect the rectangle is selected

contain: fully enclosed line and arrow are selected, a partly enclosed arrow is not: given contain mode; line at x 300 y 300 and arrow at x 300 y 500, both default 100x100 points; first a surrounding lasso around the line, then (no shift) a rectangular lasso x 260..350, y 460..640 that holds only the arrow's first half, then a surrounding lasso x 260..440, y 460..640, expect line selected; then nothing selected; then the arrow selected

contain: container is selected only when its label is enclosed too: given contain mode; labelled rectangle per rule 6; lasso around the whole container with 40px margin, expect only the container is selected (the label is never in the selection)

contain: lasso enclosing an arrow but crossing its label does not select it: given contain mode, then overlap; `API.createLabeledArrow()` moved with API.updateElement to x 300 y 300 (points 0,0 to 100,100; 50x20 label centred at 350,350); the same thin diagonal band lasso (296,276),(424,404),(404,424),(276,296) drawn in each mode, expect contain: nothing selected; overlap: the arrow is selected
contain: lasso around only the label selects nothing: given contain mode; labelled rectangle per rule 6; lasso tightly around the label (x 295..365, y 295..335), expect nothing selected
contain: locked element is ignored: given contain mode; locked rectangle x 300 y 300 100x100; surrounding lasso, expect nothing selected

contain: wrapping one group member selects the whole group: given contain mode; two rectangles with groupIds ["g1"] at x 300 and x 600 (y 300, 100x100); surrounding lasso around the first only, expect both rectangles selected and h.state.selectedGroupIds.g1 is true
overlap: crossing one group member selects the whole group: given overlap mode; same two grouped rectangles; crossing band lasso through the first only, expect both rectangles selected

contain: wrapped frame drops its wrapped children: given contain mode; frame x 200 y 200 300x300 and a child rectangle x 300 y 300 100x100 with frameId set to the frame id; lasso around the frame with 40px margin, expect only the frame is selected

contain: shift keeps the previous selection: given contain mode; rectangles A at x 100 y 100 and B at x 500 y 500 (100x100); surrounding lasso around A, then a shift lasso around B, expect A and B selected

switching the preference changes the next lasso: given rectangle x 300 y 300 100x100 and the partial lasso; draw in contain, then API.setAppState overlap and draw the same lasso, then contain again, expect nothing, then the rectangle, then nothing

omitted boxSelectionMode behaves as overlap: given rectangle x 300 y 300 100x100; direct getLassoSelectedElementIds calls per rule 7 with the partial lasso path, expect omitted and "overlap" both return [rectangle.id]; "contain" returns []
